bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 171, Number 108 (Tuesday, June 24, 2025)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. MESSMER:
H.R. 4107.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
U.S. Constitution--Art. 1--SEC.8
The Congress shall have power to raise and support armies
Provide and maintain a Navy
Make Rules for the Government and regulation of the land
and Naval Forces.
[Page H2923]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Armed Services, and in addition to the Committees on Foreign Affairs, the Judiciary, and Transportation and Infrastructure, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
